Veterans Benefits: Florida has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed at the state level. Florida offers a homestead exemption up to $50,000, a $5,000 property-tax exemption at a 10%+ service-connected disability rating, and a full homestead exemption for 100% permanent-and-total service-connected disabled veterans, with an additional age-65+ combat-disability discount and surviving-spouse continuation.

Description: Panama City is a Gulf Coast Florida city anchored by Naval Support Activity Panama City (Naval Surface Warfare Center) and, ~12 miles east, Tyndall Air Force Base (325th Fighter Wing, rebuilding as an F-35 base after Hurricane Michael). It offers nearby VA outpatient care, Florida's no-income-tax treatment of military retirement pay, Gulf beaches, and Walmart access. Tradeoffs include a high crime rate, Gulf hurricane exposure, and no in-city Costco.
